title: CI and Deployment Failure Triage
description: Ingest CI and deployment failures, classify likely cause with evidence, perform safe policy actions, and route the result.
setup_prompt: Use CI and Deployment Failure Triage with my delivery systems. Configure authenticated event intake, exact run/change identity, evidence collection and redaction, classification, safe rerun/escalation rules, dashboard reporting, and Slack collaboration where selected.

setup_inputs.label: CI/CD providers, repositories, services, and environments
Webhook, manual, or polling intake and event schemas
Log, artifact, change, deployment, and health access
Taxonomy, retry, escalation, retention, and redaction policy

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks API trigger
recommended_tools.purpose: Start the saved triage route from authenticated CI or deployment events

recommended_tools.name: CI/CD MCP or CLI
recommended_tools.purpose: Read run, stage, log, artifact, change, and deployment evidence

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks Slack bot
recommended_tools.purpose: Support threaded failure investigation, decisions, and status questions

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks workflow database
recommended_tools.purpose: Persist normalized failures, evidence, actions, and receipts
